_comment: All five fire-and-forget extension_ui_request methods (SRD §4.2's vocabulary table: notify, setStatus, setWidget, setTitle, set_editor_text) arrive mid-turn, each carrying an id an answer could be addressed to. Nothing is waiting on them, so the double never blocks: the turn ends on its own agent_end. ISC-113 is the pair of facts this exercises — the supervisor must LOG each one and must send NOTHING back for any of them. The dialog class (select/confirm/input/editor) is deliberately absent: those block until answered and belong to ISC-111/112, which no code satisfies yet.
